message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on facts: The defendant set off firecrackers (二踢脚) in hallway to drive away rats, causing fire, property damage, personal injury. This is likely "过失放火罪" (negligent arson) under Chinese criminal law. Also possibly "过失致人重伤罪"? He caused his own back burn, but that's not victim. The main is negligent arson causing property damage. Also "非法使用爆炸物罪"? But using fireworks causing fire may be "放火罪" (arson) if intentional, but here it's negligence. So "过失放火罪". Also maybe "危害公共安全罪"? But typical is "过失放火罪". So answer single charge.

Thus format: [罪名]过失放火罪<eoa>
